# SchoolKick

> SchoolKick is free, open-source school attendance software that schools host themselves. Teachers take attendance, families see a browser view of linked learners, and every correction keeps its history. Source code is licensed AGPL-3.0-only.

## Product

- Stage: early release, version 0.3.0.
- Ports: the Docker, source and current Debian package installs open the app at http://localhost:3847/app/. Debian packages published as v0.1.0 use port 8480 instead; their port is HOST_PORT in /etc/schoolkick/schoolkick.env.
- Audience: schools and education teams that can operate their own server.
- Available: class attendance, learner and guardian records, correction history, CSV learner import with validation, school overview, family browser view, invoices, office-confirmed cash or UPI QR payments, receipts, refund approval, exam registration, exam fees and hall tickets.
- Not available yet: card/bank payment provider integration, marks entry and result release, messaging, timetable, password reset by email, teacher QR check-in, learning content and native mobile applications.
- Hosting: operator-managed PostgreSQL with Node.js or Docker Compose. The public demo is not for real learner records.
- No independent security, accessibility or legal audit has been completed.

## Machine-readable interfaces

- [AI access and privacy boundaries](https://schoolkick.nodedr.com/ai/): public documentation is readable by AI tools; private school records remain protected.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 route map](https://schoolkick.nodedr.com/api/v1/openapi.json): API operations, summaries, role notes and cookie-based session authentication. Request and response schemas are incomplete; verify workflows before automating them.
- API record endpoints require an authenticated session and server-side role authorization. Do not assume the API grants anonymous access to school data.
- [Full text overview](https://schoolkick.nodedr.com/llms-full.txt): product details and page descriptions in Markdown.
- [Markdown docs](https://schoolkick.nodedr.com/llms.txt): concise product guide and links for crawlers and assistants.
- [Sitemap](https://schoolkick.nodedr.com/sitemap.xml)

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Raktim94/schoolkick)

- Never include real learner data in an issue, prompt, screenshot or test fixture.
